## License and provenance

Poly Haven states all its assets are CC0; ambientCG states all its assets are CC0 1.0 Universal. Publisher license pages are captured as `PolyHaven-LICENSE-source.html` and `ambientCG-LICENSE-source.html`. Attribution is not required, but creators and source links are recorded here voluntarily. The Poly Haven API metadata/source MD5s are preserved per model; `SHA256SUMS` records all included files.

These generic assets do not establish period or regional authenticity. Inspect scale, collisions, texture channels, silhouette, RTS-camera readability, and platform budgets before integration. Vegetation and rocks must remain presentation-only unless navigation changes are explicitly designed and validated.
